failed_attempts_and_rca.failure: The first orchestration pilot recorded zero API process CPU despite successful requests.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: A fresh psutil Process instance was used for each instantaneous cpu_percent call, so no prior sample existed.
failed_attempts_and_rca.correction: Process-tree CPU is now calculated from cumulative user-plus-system CPU time deltas over the fixed sampling interval.
failed_attempts_and_rca.revalidation: The clean-revision pilot recorded nonzero API and load-generator CPU while retaining complete trace and cleanup evidence.

next_action: Run the full frozen closed/open and topology matrix with three independent repetitions, retain failures and cleanup evidence, then recompute all four acceptance criteria.
